spec.description: Common exporter health dashboard for __PROJECT_NAME__. It uses framework-owned collection metrics, Go runtime metrics, process metrics, and Prometheus scrape metadata.

spec.title: Collection Success
spec.description: Ratio of exporter instances whose last framework collection succeeded.

spec.title: Exporter Targets
spec.description: Number of exporter targets scraped under the selected job.

spec.title: Last Collection Age
spec.description: Average age of the latest framework collection attempt.

spec.title: Last Successful Age
spec.description: Average age of the latest successful framework collection.

spec.title: Exporter Runtime Snapshot
spec.description: Per-instance build metadata, uptime, memory, goroutines, and open file descriptors.

spec.title: Collection Success by Instance
spec.description: Framework collection success state reported by each exporter instance.

spec.title: Collection Attempt Age
spec.description: Age of the latest collection attempt.

spec.title: Successful Collection Age
spec.description: Age of the latest successful collection.

spec.title: Exporter Scrape Up
spec.description: Prometheus scrape reachability for exporter targets.

spec.title: Exporter Scrape Duration
spec.description: Prometheus scrape duration for exporter targets.

spec.title: Exporter Scrape Samples
spec.description: Samples scraped and retained after metric relabeling.

spec.title: Exporter CPU
spec.description: Exporter process CPU usage over five minutes.

spec.title: Exporter Memory
spec.description: Process RSS and Go heap memory.

spec.title: Exporter Heap Detail
spec.description: Go heap allocation, in-use, idle, and released memory.

spec.title: Exporter Goroutines
spec.description: Number of active goroutines.

spec.title: Exporter GC Rate
spec.description: Go garbage collection cycles per second over five minutes.

spec.title: Exporter Open FDs
spec.description: Open file descriptors and process limit when exposed by the platform.

spec.title: Exporter Network I/O
spec.description: Process network receive and transmit byte rate when exposed by the platform.

spec.title: Exporter Threads
spec.description: Go runtime OS threads and GOMAXPROCS.

spec.title: Exporter Heap Objects
spec.description: Number of live Go heap objects by exporter instance.

spec.title: Exporter Allocation Rate
spec.description: Go heap allocation throughput over five minutes.

spec.title: Exporter FD Usage Ratio
spec.description: Ratio of open file descriptors to the process file descriptor limit.

spec.title: Exporter Average GC Pause
spec.description: Average Go garbage collection pause duration over five minutes.

spec.title: Exporter New Series Added
spec.description: Approximate number of new Prometheus series discovered during each scrape.

spec.title: Exporter Collection Duration
spec.description: Average framework collection refresh duration over five minutes. Requires exporters built with a framework version that exports __METRIC_NAMESPACE___collection_duration_seconds.

spec.title: Source Up / Valid
spec.description: Optional feature source health gauges emitted by file or source collectors.

spec.title: Source MTime Age
spec.description: Age of optional source modification timestamps.

spec.title: Source Refresh Duration
spec.description: Optional source-level refresh duration emitted by file or source collectors.

spec.title: Source Error Rate
spec.description: Optional source read and parse error rates over five minutes.

spec.title: __PROJECT_DESC__

spec.name: job
spec.label: job
spec.description: Prometheus scrape job exposing exporter metrics
